$comment: The Realm Seal and the carved alphabet the wordmark is set in. Single source of truth for the mark's geometry — src/ui/Mark.tsx renders it as SVG, tools/gen-icons.py rasterises the favicons and the social card from these same numbers. Change it here and everything follows. All coordinates are y-down.

bezel.$comment: A carved tablet, chamfered top-right and bottom-left — the same notch the .panel component cuts, so the mark and every surface it sits on are the same object.

rune.$comment: A stave piercing a bound gate. Deliberately SYMMETRICAL, which is the one place in the system that is: a player's sigil is struck asymmetrically off its stave because it is theirs and imperfect, and the seal is the rune those are measured against.

bind.$comment: The one stroke in the mark that carries chroma. Everything else is bone-gold chrome; the bind bar takes the element, so the logo states which faction you are in for exactly the same reason every other surface does.

alphabet.$comment: The wordmark is not set in a font. It is carved from the same vocabulary as the rune — straight strokes, mitred joins, chamfers instead of curves, and not one arc anywhere. Only the letters the name needs exist; adding one means drawing it. Glyph box is 60 wide, cap height runs y=8 to y=92.

colors.$comment: Mirrors the tokens in src/index.css. The raster generator has no CSS, so the values live here rather than being duplicated in a script.
